'''Estalle''' was a [[City/Legends|city]] on the [[Estalle Island|island]] of the same name on the planet [[Procopia/Legends|Procopia]]. Since the formation of the [[Tapani Empire]] the city was the seat of power within the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. It was the location of [[The Palace]], the residence of the [[Emperor (Tapani)|Emperors]], and later of the [[Senate Building (Procopia)|Senate Building]] and [[Great Council Chambers]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial era]] the entire island was covered by the Urban sprawl of Estalle city.<ref name="LE" />
